455:t_3:15.en:
$$ジン$$
「There's no point trying to teach $$カグラ$$ common sense.」

455:t_3:16.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut up, $$ジン$$. Now that old man $$不動$$'s gone, I'll do whatever I like.」

455:t_3:17.en:
$$アポロ$$
「It looks like that old man pushes you around too.」

455:t_3:18.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh heh... Yeah. Is it the same for you?」

455:t_3:19.en:
$$アポロ$$
「It seems that old man $$不動$$ is a pain in every era.」

455:t_3:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$カグラ$$ really inherited $$アポロ$$'s wild-child side strongly. They're already perfectly in sync.」

455:t_3:21.en:
$$シン$$
「But I wonder if $$ディーバ$$'s Commander $$不動$$ and $$ネオディーヴァ$$'s Supreme Commander $$不動$$ really are connected...」

455:t_3:22.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They're probably related... Or he's a reincarnation.」

455:t_3:23.en:
$$キラ$$
「They're alike in how they appear out of nowhere and how you can't predict what they'll do, too.」

455:t_3:24.en:
$$カグラ$$
「But that old man's gone now!」

455:t_3:27.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Got a problem with that, $$アマタ$$!?」

455:t_3:28.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Are you saying you'll stop us?」

455:t_3:29.en:
$$カグラ$$
「No way, no way...! This guy's a spineless wimp unless $$ミコノ$$'s involved!」

455:t_3:30.en:
$$アポロ$$
「To think this guy is my reincarnation... I'm ashamed of myself.」

455:t_3:31.en:
$$アマタ$$
「When I look at you, $$アポロ$$, I kind of feel the same way.」

455:t_3:32.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Anyway, someone over here seems angry about that sniffing you did earlier.」

455:t_3:33.en:
$$シリウス$$
「$$カグラ$$, was it...? If you disrespect my sister $$シルヴィア$$, I, $$シリウス・ド・アリシア$$, will be your opponent.」

455:t_3:35.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Then leave the training of this stray dog to me.」

455:t_3:39.en:
$$ジン$$
「It looks like those two have their new owners now.」

455:t_3:40.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$, what did you do after we parted ways?」

455:t_3:41.en:
$$ジン$$
「I've been training my $$エレメント$$ abilities the whole time. Unlike you, $$ユノハ$$, we've hardly had any training at $$聖天使学園$$.」

455:t_3:43.en:
$$シュレード$$
「It's been a while for you too, Chairwoman.」

455:t_3:44.en:
$$クレア$$
「With $$不動$$ absent, I will take command of both $$アクエリオン$$s.」

455:t_3:45.en:
$$クレア$$
「Now, would the $$ディーバ$$ $$エレメント$$s introduce themselves?」

455:t_3:46.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I'm $$シリウス・ド・アリシア$$. I see many familiar faces, but my sister $$シルヴィア$$ and I will be counting on you once again.」

455:t_3:47.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I'm $$シルヴィア・ド・アリシア$$. Since $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ can't transform, I'll devote myself to supporting $$アポロ$$ this time.」

455:t_3:48.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Aren't you gonna say, 'My ideal man is my brother $$シリウス$$'?」

455:t_3:50.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Quit saying stupid things. There's someone waiting behind you.」

455:t_3:51.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm $$アポロ$$. Well... I'm counting on you.」

455:t_3:52.en:
$$ファ$$
($$アポロ$$... It looks like he was covering for $$シルヴィア$$.)

455:t_3:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Those two seem to be getting along nicely.)

455:t_3:54.en:
$$アンディ$$
「But setting aside $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$, who were sleeping in a gap between dimensions...」

455:t_3:55.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「How did you get to this era, $$シルヴィア$$...?」

455:t_3:56.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I don't really understand either, but I think it was Commander $$不動$$'s power.」

455:t_3:57.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「You mean $$ディーバ$$'s commander?」

455:t_3:58.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Yes... He appeared out of nowhere, as usual, and asked if I wanted to see $$アポロ$$...」

455:t_3:59.en:
$$モロイ$$
「So you answered and were sent to this world, twelve thousand years later.」

455:t_3:60.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Your Commander $$不動$$ is quite something too.」

455:t_3:61.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「But was that all right? You had friends and family in the world twelve thousand years ago, didn't you?」

455:t_3:62.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Yes... I might... never see $$麗花$$, $$ピエール$$, or the others again...」

455:t_3:63.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「But I wanted to see him anyway.」

455:t_3:64.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You wanted to see $$アポロ$$?」

455:t_3:65.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I wanted to see my brother too!」

455:t_3:66.en:
$$シン$$
「You're not denying that you wanted to see $$アポロ$$.」

455:t_3:67.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's a huge step forward for $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_3:70.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I understand... how you feel, $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_3:71.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「A forbidden love for her brother, spanning twelve thousand years...! It makes my heart melt...!」

455:t_3:73.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Whatever. From now on, we'll be counting on $c to take us in too.」

455:t_3:74.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you sure? You're deciding awfully quickly.」

455:t_3:75.en:
$$アポロ$$
「The future $$シリウス$$, $$頭翅#pilot$$, and I risked our lives to protect is part of this world, right?」

455:t_3:76.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If anyone wants to do whatever they please with it, like the guys we fought today, they'll have to deal with me.」

455:t_3:77.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I feel the same. I'll fight in $$アクエリオン$$ for this world.」

455:t_3:78.en:
$$アンディ$$
「$$神話型アクエリオン$$'s joined us. Now there's nothing to fear!」

455:t_3:79.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Your $$アクエリオン$$'s pretty good too.」

455:t_3:80.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$ was certainly developed from $$神話型アクエリオン$$, but...」

455:t_3:81.en:
$$クレア$$
「Since $$アクエリオン$$ draws its power from its pilots' feelings, the difference between the machines should make little difference in combat strength.」

455:t_3:82.en:
$$カグラ$$
「So basically, if $$ＥＶＯＬ$$ loses to $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$, it's $$アマタ$$'s fault.」

455:t_3:84.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「It'll be all right... I'm sure you can fight just as well as $$アポロ$$, $$アマタ$$.」

455:t_3:86.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You said you felt pathetic earlier, but I don't think that about you.」

455:t_3:87.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Because you always protect me and give me courage, $$アマタ$$.」

455:t_3:89.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I... will keep protecting you. That much I promise.」

455:t_3:93.en:
$$ジン$$
「Don't worry about it. This happens all the time.」
